subject: sitting cat with tall ears and curled tail
concept: A chunky, symmetrical orange tabby cat sitting upright, facing the viewer, with a round head, two pointed slope-brick ears, a cream muzzle and chest, and a short stubby tail built from two or three bricks curling up behind.
features: Pointed triangular ears made from small slopes
Round face with big round-tile eyes and a small pink nose
Orange body with darker stripes across the back and head
Short chunky tail sticking up behind
simplifications: Whiskers dropped, or replaced by two short grey bars per side, because thin flexible whiskers cannot be built reliably
Long curved tail became a 2-3 brick upright stub because free-standing curves are not buildable
Stalking or pouncing pose became a calm sitting pose so the model balances on a wide base
Fur texture and realistic face became flat colour blocking with stripes made from 1-2 stud tile bands, avoiding printed or stickered details
Paws became simple rounded plates at the base instead of individually shaped toes
